name: Sgt. Lowry (or Lowery)
summary: A Special Forces sergeant Larry remembers as operating or being stationed on top of Núi Bà Đen (Black Virgin Mountain) — and the man who confronted him on the "450 civilians" day at the end of his tour. The correct spelling of his name and his identity remain unresolved.
researchNotes: The spellings are transcriptions by Larry's son of the name as Larry says it. Both spellings should be searched in Special Forces rosters, unit records, and veteran accounts of Núi Bà Đen operations during 1964-1965. No documentary match has been found yet. The accusation day (data/timeline/1965-08-450-civilians-accusation.json) makes identifying him doubly important: he is the one named witness to whatever happened. His name should also be checked against the roster-rock names in VN-0035 and VN-0133.
